policy: Employees must badge individually into restricted areas
and may not admit another person using their credential.
Visitors must verify identity, receive temporary identification,
remain in approved areas, and be escorted in restricted zones.
Unattended devices must be locked and sensitive information
Workstation Security.risk: Shoulder surfing and physical information exposure
Workstation Security.controls: Screen locks, privacy filters, workstation positioning

policy: TitanTech uses unique credentials, MFA where appropriate,
Unapproved removable media is prohibited on restricted systems.
Ports may be disabled where business need does not require them.
Removable Media.risk: Unauthorized physical device or port access
Removable Media.controls: Endpoint policy, port restrictions, endpoint controls

policy: Sensitive paper must be placed in approved locked destruction
containers and may not be placed in ordinary trash.
Document Disposal.controls: Locked destruction bins, shredding, clean-desk policy

policy: Critical systems use UPS and surge protection. Selected services
receive generator support, backups, and tested recovery procedures.
Power and Continuity.controls: UPS, surge protection, generator, backups, recovery

policy: Employees must report suspicious activity. Alerts trigger
investigation and do not automatically prove compromise or intent.
Monitoring and Reporting.controls: Logging, cameras, access records, employee reporting
